frame.unwrap: u=R*radians((45-theta) mod 360); v=-Y; u increases in readable inscription direction
frame.glyph_surface_orientation: dP/du cross dP/dv points radially outward; letters are not mirrored

blank.physical_manufacturing_tolerance: not specified; design nominal dimensions only

edge.occlusion_rule: engrave the common master, remove actual missing metal, then let claws occlude remaining marks; do not reflow or add replacement text
edge.reading_direction: theta decreases as Latin text reads left-to-right; caps toward -Y/obverse

protected_front_features: two prominent front talons in upper-left grip
two prominent front talons in lower-right grip

overrides.engraving_clearance_policy: construction-access envelope only; do not suppress or rearrange glyphs automatically
overrides.notch_envelope_interpolation: piecewise-linear between knots; this is a construction envelope, not a replacement for fracture sculpt
overrides.notch_rule: same missing metal passes through base thickness, front and reverse share the same world-space cut; this profile is the outer-envelope construction guide, not a replacement for organic fracture sculpt
overrides.grip_rule: sectors locate construction envelopes only; finger anatomy/face silhouette remain governed by approved source, do not extrude an angular wedge into a claw

book.fit: uniform contain; preserve original SVG aspect ratio

reverse.organic_foliage_rule: retain visual language of the complete reference within bounded regions; region boxes define placement, not new botanical species or exact freehand leaf topology

compare SVG/JSON/CSV and source-bound silhouette before any visual promotion
